summary: Frontend-only tests executed for OBJECTS interactive digital-exhibition. All 8 required flows pass: page load & header, 8 spatial objects with post-intro opacity, horizontal drag with inertia + wheel scroll, hover (is-hover class + other-object dim to 0.38), click-to-open product modal with all metadata, add-to-bag increments header count and toggles button text, modal close via close button and via Escape, menu overlay open/close, bottom drag cue text, and no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductView useLayoutEffect calls sourceTransform() which uses sourceEl.getBoundingClientRect(); if sourceEl is unmounted or detached the modal open animation could fail. Currently safe because dimmed keeps stage in DOM.

Exhibition.js useEffect dep array includes callbacks (onOpen/onActiveChange/onDragChange) from App which are recreated each render for two of them (setActiveIndex/setDragging are stable state setters, but the whole effect would tear down + rebuild Lenis/Draggable if callback identity changed). Currently stable since they are useState setters and useCallback, but any future refactor could cause an expensive re-init.
Header logo lacks explicit width/height causing possible CLS during load.
MenuOverlay pointer-events initialized state relies on CSS; on first render before effect runs, links may be technically hoverable but hidden — minor accessibility concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend viewport 1920x800. Note: after horizontal drag/wheel, most objects go off-screen. Any test that hovers/clicks a specific object must first check its bounding box is within the viewport (or reload page). Product opens via GSAP Draggable onClick handler on the .ex-stage trigger — use short mouse.down()/mouse.up() at the object's center (not page.click, which is fine too since Draggable synthesizes click). Escape and close button both close the modal. All required data-testids are present.
